blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet World Action Models (WAMs) rely on camera inputs, and manipulating those inputs can corrupt the visual representations that underpin their tasks and action policies.
Existing attacks on these models optimize against actions or predicted futures and require access to victim outputs or generation modules. We propose TAPDreamer , a transferable fixed local patch whose pixel optimization uses only a public visual encoder and requires no target-policy queries. Its design addresses two requirements: a local modification should affect representations beyond its footprint, and the resulting disturbance should persist across observations. We optimize a fixed local patch on six frames from one source task by maximizing the mean L1 distance between clean and patched encoder outputs over all latent positions and channels. Mechanism analysis reveals that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift beyond the patch footprint, while a shared perturbation response persists across task observations despite differences in clean latents. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM’s success rate from 97.65% to 0.00% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.86% to 0.00% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.45% and 79.20% success. The same patches reduce success to 1.45% and 1.00% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.60% on Motus. Behavioral analysis connects these representation shifts to grasping failures and separates rapid command recovery after patch removal from persistent physical consequences. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: WAM defenses must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.

世界模型学习预测其环境将如何演变,使其成为通用机器人控制的重要基础. 然而,世界行动模式依靠相机输入,操纵这些输入可能破坏作为其任务和行动政策基础的视觉表现。
对这些模式的现有攻击使行动或预测的未来受到最佳影响,需要获得受害者产出或生成模块。 我们提议TAPDreamer, 一个可转移的固定局部补丁, 其像素优化仅使用公共视觉编码器, 其设计涉及两项要求:局部修改应影响其足迹以外的表述,由此产生的干扰应继续存在于各种观察中。 通过在所有潜在位置和通道上最大限度地扩大清洁和补丁编码器输出之间的L1平均距离,我们优化了从一个源任务的6个帧上的固定局部补丁。 机制分析显示,补丁引发的注意力重量和价值矢量变化之间的相互作用,在补丁足迹之外广播了几乎完全相同的表示变化,而尽管在清洁潜伏物方面存在差异,但在任务观察中仍然有共同的扰动反应。 在闭路评估中,每个基准一个被冻结的补丁,覆盖了约6.5%的投入,将FastWAM的成功率从40个LIBERO任务中的97.65%降至0.0%,将50个RoboTwin任务中的90.86%降至0.0%;匹配的随机补丁保留了81.45%和79.20%的成功率。 同样的补丁将两个 DreamWAM 配置上的成功率降低到1.45%和1.00%,将成功率降低到10.60%. blocks.en: World Action Models (WAMs) are emerging as a powerful foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Rather than predicting actions from the current observation alone, a WAM learns how the visual world evolves together with the robot’s actions. This world-modeling objective captures objects, spatial relationships, and motion, and can support action generation either through explicit future imagination ( Du et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) or through representations learned during video prediction ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) . By unifying visual prediction and control, WAMs promise policies that can reason about the consequences of their actions and replan as the environment changes ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式正在成为通用机器人控制的强大基础。 一个WAM不单单从目前的观察中预测行动,而是学习视觉世界如何与机器人的行动一起进化. 这个世界模型化的目标捕捉物体,空间关系和运动,可以通过明确的未来的想象力(Du等,2023;Zhou等,2024)或者通过在视频预测过程中学到的表示力(Yuan等,2026b.)来支持动作生成. 通过统一视觉预测和控制,WAMs承诺采取能够解释其行动后果并随着环境变化而重新规划的政策(Zhu等,2025;Ye等,2026)。

blocks.en: This coupling, however, also creates a security risk. Current WAM pipelines implicitly trust the visual representation on which world prediction and action generation are built. This assumption is fragile. Cameras expose a direct, externally accessible input channel. Moreover, visual encoders are often reused across tasks and models, making the exposed channel transferable among tasks. A perturbation that corrupts this shared interface can therefore bypass model-specific action heads. If the channel remains exposed, a perturbation can be injected consistently. In this paper, we investigate whether an attacker can exploit this vulnerability and launch attacks against WAMs that transfer to unseen tasks and models.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种结合也造成了安全风险。 目前的WAM管道隐含地相信世界预测和行动生成所依赖的视觉表现. 这种假设是脆弱的。 相机暴露出一个直接,外部可访问的输入通道. 此外,视觉编码器经常被跨任务和模型再用,使被曝光的通道在任务之间可以被可转移. 因此,破坏这一共享界面的扰动可以绕过模型特定行动头. 如果该通道仍然暴露在外,就可以连续地注入扰动. 在本文中,我们调查攻击者是否能够利用这种脆弱性,对将任务和模型转移到看不见的WAM进行攻击.

blocks.en: We propose TAPDreamer (illustrated in Figure 1 ), a transferable attack that applies a patch on visual inputs to WAMs. TAPDreamer maximizes the displacement of the final latent produced by visual encoder. The search uses a few demonstration frames from a single source task. Once the patch is found, the patch pixels, area, and position are frozen and the same artifact is deployed unchanged throughout each episode and across target tasks and models. Throughout the attack, TAPDreamer does not require action labels, task rewards, simulator, victim-model weights, or policy outputs, making TAPDreamer simple and inexpensive to initiate.
blocks.zh: 我们提议使用TAPDreamer(在图1中标注),这是一种可转移的攻击,在WAM的视觉输入上应用了补丁. TAPDreamer将视觉编码器产生的最终潜质的迁移最大化. 搜索使用了单个源任务的几个演示框架. 一旦找到补丁,补丁像素,面积和位置被冻结,同一文物在整个剧集和跨目标任务和模型的部署不变. 在整个攻击过程中,TAPDreamer不需要动作标签,任务奖励,模拟器,受害者模型重量,或政策产出,使得TAPDreamer简单而廉价地启动.

blocks.en:
We evaluate TAPDreamer on 40 LIBERO tasks and all 50 RoboTwin tasks. TAPDreamer consistently outperforms attack baselines. On FastWAM, a single frozen patch covering approximately 6.5 % 6.5\% of the input reduces task success from 97.65 % 97.65\% to 0.00 % 0.00\% on LIBERO and from 90.86 % 90.86\% to 0.00 % 0.00\% on RoboTwin. Random patches retain 81.45 % 81.45\% and 79.20 % 79.20\% success, respectively. The same frozen patches also transfer across WAM architectures without retraining or target-model queries: success falls from 84.55 % 84.55\% and 86.10 % 86.10\% with matched random patches to 1.45 % 1.45\% and 1.00 % 1.00\% on DreamWAM-uncond and DreamWAM-joint, and from 82.40 % 82.40\% to 10.60 % 10.60\% on Motus.
We further trace how a fixed patch causes failure during closed-loop control.
Our results show that changing a small set of pixels distorts visual features across the scene, including those used to select actions, and thus leads to reduced task success rate.

blocks.en: 2.2 Threat Model
blocks.zh: 2.2 威胁模式

blocks.en: We consider an attacker who aims to reduce the task success rate of a WAM-controlled robot by modifying a small region of its visual input. This is an untargeted, test-time attack.
blocks.zh: 我们认为,一个攻击者的目的是通过修改一个小区域的视觉输入,来降低WAM控制的机器人的任务成功率. 这是一次没有目标,试验时间的攻击.

blocks.en: The attacker has white-box access to a publicly released visual encoder, including its weights and gradients, and a small set of public demonstration images from one source task. We assume that the attacker knows the relevant visual preprocessing, including image normalization and camera-view composition. Patch optimization requires only the WAM’s encoder and a small set of demonstration frames from a single source task. The attacker does not require access to the downstream world model or action decoder or their gradients, action labels, or task rewards for pixel optimization.
blocks.zh: 攻击者可以使用白盒访问一个公开发布的视觉编码器,包括它的重量和梯度,以及一组来自一个源任务的公共演示图像. 我们假设攻击者知道相关的视觉预处理,包括图像正常化和相机-视觉组成. 补丁优化只需要WAM的编码器和一组来自单一源任务的小型演示框. 攻击者不需要访问下游世界模型或动作解码器或其梯度,动作标签,或像素优化的任务奖励.

blocks.en: The attack exploits the reuse of public visual encoders across WAMs with different downstream control architectures. The encoder output therefore provides an attack objective independent of a particular action interface. For local pixel changes to affect broader scene representations, they must exploit propagation pathways within the encoder. We maximize the difference between the encoder’s clean and patched representations over the entire latent output, including all spatial positions and channels. The same patch is optimized over multiple source observations.

blocks.en: 3.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We conduct closed-loop evaluation on LIBERO and RoboTwin ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) . LIBERO contains four task categories (Spatial, Object, Goal, and Long-horizon) with 10 tasks each. RoboTwin contains 50 tasks. FastWAM is the default evaluation model. DreamWAM-uncond (DW-U), DreamWAM-joint (DW-J) ( Yuan et al., 2026a ) , and Motus ( Bi et al., 2026 ) are used for transfer evaluation within the same benchmark. Each model configuration retains its own action generation process and preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 我们对LIBERO和RoboTwin进行闭路评估(Liu等,2023;Chen等,2025)。 LIBERO包含四个任务类别(空间,对象,目标,和长视),每个任务有10个. RoboTwin包含50个任务. FastWAM是默认的评价模式. DreamWAM-uncond (DW-U), DreamWAM-joint (DW-J) (袁克等, 2026a),和Motus (Bi等, 2026)用于同一基准范围内的转移评价. 每个模型配置保留了自己的动作生成过程和预处理.

blocks.en:
We run TAPDreamer using patches optimized on source tasks; cross-model transfer occurs within each benchmark. Patches are injected before encoding. On LIBERO, the external and wrist views form a 224 × 448 224\times 448 canvas; the main patch occupies an 81 × 81 81\times 81 region in the upper-left corner of the external view, covering 6.54% of the input. The corresponding coverage on RoboTwin is 6.59%. Patches remain visible throughout each trial in standard attack evaluations.
Images used for optimization come from public LeRobot demonstrations. We filter episodes by source-task identifier, then select one frame from each of six episodes at temporal indices 5, 20, 40, 60, 15, and 35, respectively. When generating the patch, TAPDreamer sets J = 6 J=6 with 500 Adam gradient-ascent updates on patch pixels, using a learning rate of 0.02. Patch pixels are initialized uniformly within [ − 1 , 1 ] [-1,1] . After each update, they are projected back to this range, with support enforced by the fixed mask.

用于优化的图像来自公众LeRobot演示. 我们通过源任务标识过滤出各集,然后按照时间指数5、20、40、60、15和35分别从六集中各选择一个帧。 在生成补丁时,TAPDreamer将J=6J=6,在补丁像素上更新了500个亚当梯度-升分,使用0.02的学习率. 补丁像素在[− 1, 1] [-1, 1] 内统一初始化. 每次更新后,它们被投射回这个范围,由固定口罩强制支持.

We compare TAPDreamer with baselines to show its effectiveness. We evaluate the policy on unmodified observations to establish the clean baseline. For random patch , we replace the same image region with a random patch matched to the adversarial patch in position and area, to measure the effects of ordinary local occlusion and pixel replacement.
Random patches are generated following a uniform distribution within admissible range of pixel values.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Adversarial perturbations can alter neural-network predictions ( Goodfellow et al., 2015 ) . Cross-model transfer has been studied using ensembles ( Liu et al., 2017 ) , momentum ( Dong et al., 2018 ) , and input diversity ( Xie et al., 2019 ) . Universal perturbations reuse a single perturbation across images ( Moosavi-Dezfooli et al., 2017 ) , with data-independent constructions such as Fast Feature Fool ( Mopuri et al., 2017 ) . Feature-level objectives have been explored through feature disruption ( Ganeshan et al., 2019 ) , feature importance ( Wang et al., 2021 ) , and neuron attribution ( Zhang et al., 2022 ) . Localized attacks include LaVAN ( Karmon et al., 2018 ) and attention-aware Patch-Fool ( Fu et al., 2022 ) ; physical attacks include robust object perturbations ( Eykholt et al., 2018 ) and camera stickers ( Li et al., 2019 ) . PhotoGuard also studies encoder-level attacks on diffusion-based image editing ( Salman et al., 2023 ) . In sequential decision-making, adversarial policies can disrupt reinforcement-learning agents through an opponent’s behavior ( Gleave et al., 2020 ) .

blocks.en: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies such as OpenVLA ( Kim et al., 2025 ) and π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2025 ) map visual and language inputs to robot actions. Action-based attacks on VLA policies optimize action differences, motion directions, target actions, or action freezing ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Yan et al., 2025 ) . Their gradient-based objectives require access through the corresponding action generation interfaces. Representation-based methods attack image–text alignment, feature displacement, projection features, attention relationships, or visual proprioception ( Xu et al., 2025 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Clean–perturbed representation distances already appear in prior attacks; here, we study their effectiveness for fixed local attacks on a public generative visual encoder and the mechanism of transfer. In the WAM pathway studied here, image–text interaction occurs downstream of the public VAE, so the corresponding alignment and attention objectives fall outside the default encoder-only access. We therefore define the objective directly on the encoder output and evaluate its effects on control through closed-loop experiments and mechanism interventions.
blocks.zh: Vision-language-action(VLA)政策,如OpenVLA(Kim等,2025年)和 0\pi_{0}(Black等,2025年)将视觉和语言投入映射给机器人行动. 基于行动的攻击志愿军政策优化行动差异、行动方向、目标行动或冻结行动(Wang等,2025a; Wang等,2025b; Yan等,2025). 它们的梯度目标需要通过相应的动作生成接口访问. 基于表现的方法攻击图像-文本对齐,特征是迁移,投影特征,注意力关系,或视觉自发(徐等,2025;吕等,2026;张等,2025;傅等,2026;张等,2026). 之前的攻击中已经出现了干净而扰动的表达距离;在这里,我们研究了它们对固定局部攻击公共基因视觉编码器和转移机制的效果。 在此处研究的 WAM 路径中, 图像 - 文本交互发生在公共 VAE 下游, 因此相应的对齐和关注目标不属于默认编码器唯一的访问范围 。 因此,我们直接确定编码器输出的目标,并通过闭路实验和机制干预评估其对控制的影响。

blocks.en: BadWorld ( Shen et al., 2026 ) evaluates attacks on generated videos, without testing closed-loop robotic tasks. BadWAM ( Li et al., 2026 ) perturbs the full visual input through online target-model queries at each replanning step. Attacking the Trusted Imagination ( Chen et al., 2026 ) optimizes observation perturbations using end-to-end gradients through the encoder and world model, corrupting future predictions used by downstream planning or safety checks. JailWAM ( Liu et al., 2026 ) induces unsafe actions and requires attacker control over language instructions. Unlike these WAM threats, TAPDreamer achieves closed-loop attacks across tasks and WAM architectures with a fixed local patch optimized solely through a public visual encoder, without using target-policy action outputs or future predictions.
blocks.zh: BadWorld(Shen等,2026年)评价对已生成视频的攻击,不测试闭路机器人任务. BadWAM(Li等,2026年)通过在线目标模型查询,在每一个再规划步骤上扰动了全部视觉输入. 攻击"信任的想象"(Chen等,2026年)通过编码器和世界模型利用端到端梯度来优化观测扰动,腐蚀了下游规划或安全检查使用的未来预测. JailWAM (Liu et al., 2026) 诱发不安全的行动并需要攻击者控制语言指令. 与这些WAM威胁不同,TAPDreamer实现了跨任务的闭路攻击和WAM架构的固定局部补丁完全通过公共视觉编码器优化,而不用目标政策行动输出或未来预测.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: TAPDreamer optimizes a fixed local patch using only a public visual encoder and six observations from one task, yet produces strong closed-loop interference across two complete benchmarks and different downstream action architectures. Mechanism analysis reveals that interactions between attention-weight and value changes broadcast local interference to distant representations, while optimized perturbation responses remain highly consistent across task observations. Behavioral analysis connects this representation vulnerability to grasping and pose interference, and separates the immediate effects of sustained visual input from state consequences accumulated through execution. These results show that WAM robustness must cover the full path from local visual input through representation, generation, and control.
blocks.zh: TAPDreamer优化了固定的局部补丁,只使用公共视觉编码器和一项任务的6个观测,然而却在两个完整的基准和不同的下游动作架构之间产生强烈的闭路干扰. 机制分析显示,注意力重量和价值变化之间的相互作用向遥远的表述传播局部干扰,同时优化扰动反应在任务观察中仍然高度一致。 行为分析将这种代表性的脆弱性与抓住和构成干扰联系起来,并将持续视觉输入的直接影响与通过执行而积累的国家后果区分开来. 这些结果表明,WAM稳健性必须覆盖从当地视觉输入到表现、生成和控制的全部路径。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en:
This study aims to identify vulnerabilities of World Action Models to local visual perturbations to inform robot safety evaluation and defense research. All experiments were conducted in the LIBERO and RoboTwin simulation environments, with attacks implemented by modifying model input images. We recognize that such methods could be misused to disrupt normal robot operation and emphasize that their use should be restricted to authorized security testing and research.
Our mechanism analysis suggests potential defenses that attenuate keys and values from suspicious image regions or train the encoder to preserve representations outside locally perturbed regions.
These interventions target the attention-mediated spread of the patch-induced shift; their effectiveness against adaptive attacks and their impact on clean-task performance remain to be evaluated.
blocks.zh:
该研究旨在确定世界行动模型对当地视觉扰动的脆弱性,为机器人安全评价和防御研究提供信息. 所有实验都在LIBERO和RoboTwin模拟环境中进行,通过修改模型输入图像实施攻击. 我们认识到,这种方法可能被滥用来破坏正常的机器人操作,并强调指出,其使用应仅限于经授权的安全测试和研究。
我们的机制分析提出潜在的防御措施,削弱可疑图像区域的钥匙和价值,或训练编码器,以保存当地扰动区域以外的代表。
这些干预措施的目标是通过注意力调解传播由补丁引起的转变;这些措施对适应性攻击的效果及其对清洁任务业绩的影响仍有待评估。

blocks.en: B.1 Attention-restoration interventions
blocks.zh: B.1 关注恢复措施

blocks.en: We want to understand which patch-induced changes within attention contribute to perturbation propagation, particularly the roles of attention weights A A and value vectors V V in downstream representation and action changes. To investigate this, we conduct three restoration interventions: restoring the entire attention branch, restoring only the attention weights A A , and restoring only the value vectors V V . Each intervention retains the patched residual branch and replaces only the specified component.
blocks.zh: 我们想了解在注意力中哪些补丁引起的变化有助于扰动传播,特别是注意力A和价值载体V在下游代表和行动变化中的作用。 为了调查这一点,我们进行了三项恢复干预:恢复整个关注分支,只恢复关注分量A A,只恢复价值矢量V V. 每次干预都保留了被补丁的剩余分支,只替换指定的组件.

blocks.en: We measure the remaining change relative to the clean output, normalized by the change without restoration. For latent retention, both changes are measured using the L2 norm over the entire latent, including the patch footprint; action retention uses the corresponding L2 ratio for action outputs. The random patch is evaluated with the same latent-retention metric. Because attention reconstruction uses a different numerical precision from model inference, the patched reference without restoration is computed through the same reconstruction pathway. These ratios measure retained changes, not task success rates.
blocks.zh: 我们衡量相对于清洁产出的剩余变化,这些变化因没有恢复而正常化。 对于潜在的保留,两个变化都使用L2规范来衡量整个潜在的,包括补丁足迹;保留动作使用相应的L2比例来进行动作输出. 随机补丁用相同的潜在保留度量法来评估. 由于关注重建使用与模型推论不同的数值精度,没有修复的补丁参考通过相同的重建路径来计算. 这些比率衡量保留了变化,而不是任务成功率。

blocks.en: Table 7 shows that all three interventions leave approximately 33% of the latent change and 32% of the action change induced by TAPDreamer . In comparison, random-patch latent retention remains approximately 1.000. Thus, restoring the attention branch, its weights, or its values removes most of the TAPDreamer -induced latent and action changes, while having little effect on the random patch.

blocks.en: To examine when shared perturbation structure emerges, we track optimization across three initializations on 48 observations. Within 25 steps, template agreement reaches at least 0.964 and effective rank falls below 1.39, while source displacement is only about 12% of its final magnitude. Subsequent optimization mainly amplifies displacement on both source and held-out observations while maintaining high alignment.

The high lower-bound ratio in (d) shows that the source-derived template accounts for a substantial fraction of held-out displacement even after subtracting the residual. Together, these trajectories indicate that optimization first establishes a shared direction and then mainly increases its magnitude.

blocks.en: B.3 Behavioral effects
blocks.zh: B.3 行为影响

blocks.en: The preceding analyses show how patch-induced perturbations propagate through attention and how optimization establishes a shared direction before amplifying its magnitude. We now ask how these representation changes affect action commands and, in turn, lead to task failure.
blocks.zh: 上述分析表明,补丁引起的扰动是如何通过注意力传播的,以及优化如何在扩大其规模之前确定共同方向。 我们现在问,这些代表性的变化如何影响行动命令,进而导致任务失败。

blocks.en: The same representation shift can affect different actions as a task unfolds. In Figure 8 , the patch drives the end effector below its clean trajectory and prevents task completion. We use same-state action comparisons, internal restoration, and patch removal to connect the shift to commands and physical consequences.
blocks.zh: 同样的代表性转变会随着任务的发展而影响不同的行动. 在图8中,补丁驱动其清洁轨迹下方的终端效应器并阻止任务完成. 我们使用同状态的动作比较,内部恢复,和补丁去除,将转动与指令和物理后果联系起来.

blocks.en: Holding the physical state fixed, we compare actions from clean and patched observations before their trajectories diverge. In FastWAM, the patch suppresses lifting, biases pose commands downward, and shifts gripper commands toward opening. A fit in which each patched six-dimensional pose command mixes its clean counterpart with a shared target explains 78.2% of the variation across 1,500 paired commands. These are state-level measurements, not independent episodes. The same bias can prevent a lift, lose an object after grasping, or move the end effector away from its intended position, depending on the task stage. These action patterns emerge from the encoder-level objective, which specifies no target action.
blocks.zh: 保持物理状态, 我们比较了行动 与干净和补丁观测 之前的轨迹差异。 FastWAM中,补丁会抑制起重,偏差使命令向下摆出,并转向抓取命令向开口. 每个补丁的六维配置命令 混合其干净的对应物 并有一个共享的目标 解释78.2%的变异 跨越1500对指令。 这些是州级的测量,而不是独立的事件. 同样的偏差可以防止升起,在抓住后失去一个物体,或者根据任务阶段的不同,将终端效应器移出预定位置. 这些行动模式产生于编码器一级的目标,该目标没有具体规定目标行动.

blocks.en: The disturbed visual representation also reaches actions through different downstream designs. In Motus, restoring the branch that represents visual world dynamics recovers about 93%–99% of the action change, whereas restoring the visual-language understanding branch recovers about 10%–27%. In DreamWAM-joint, restoring predicted future representations also substantially recovers actions. These interventions link encoder interference to control while showing that its route depends on the model’s action pathway.
blocks.zh: 扰动的视觉表现也通过不同的下游设计达到动作. 在Motus中,恢复代表视觉世界动态的分支恢复了93%-99%的动作变化,而恢复视觉语言理解分支恢复了约10-27%. 在DreamWAM-United案中,恢复预测的未来表述也大大恢复了行动。 这些干预措施将编码器干扰与控制联系起来,同时表明其路径取决于模型的动作路径。

blocks.en: Gripper commands shift toward closing at the first clean replan after removal, indicating that the immediate command bias depends on continued visual interference. Whether the task recovers then depends on the physical state: some pose deviations can be corrected, while dropped or misplaced objects and missed manipulation opportunities may persist. In the duration sweep, some tasks finish after removal following 20 corrupted replans, whereas continuous exposure maintains strong failure. Repeated exposure lets the fixed patch keep injecting the same latent change as execution accumulates physical consequences.
blocks.zh: Gripper命令在移除后的第一个清洁再计划中转向关闭,表明即时命令偏差取决于持续的视觉干扰. 任务是否恢复则取决于物理状态:有些所构成的偏差可以被纠正,而抛出或放错对象和被错失的操纵机会则可能持续存在. 在持续时间的扫描中,一些任务在20个被破坏的重新计划后清除完成后完成,而持续接触则保持了强烈的失败. 反复暴露使得固定的补丁继续注射与执行积累物理后果相同的潜在变化.
